title: Unresolved family revocation blocks owner contact query
diagnosis: Jonah has an active ownership grant but unresolved controls from revoking family access. The broad hold also blocks the patient reading the surviving current-contact plan. The query packet is empty.

Use your main cell 510-555-0112 for normal calls. Use 628-555-0133 as the text-first backup. We should not use shared-line voicemails for treatment details.

Urgency does not restore deleted shared-line contact details. Use current approved contact methods only.
